change: pow2 grid baseline after the coop overflow-valve fix (130 points, 650 verifies green)

coop_g from a measured 8x7 table instead of a 256-block target; M=128 N=1M 225 -> 127 us. (A first reading showed prefill 195.65 -- an artifact of grouping by the REPORTED path: M=128 N=16384 got coop_g=1 and so moved from decode to prefill. Scoring now groups by a static regime.)

small_n block size from a measured 13x3 table; removes a reproducible +12.1% outlier at M=2048 N=4096 (41.7 -> 37.3 us). phase_a/phase_c occupancy formula left alone: already worst +3.4% / mean +0.1% over 91 sampled-path points, so no table is warranted there.

N_lds boundary made M-dependent: small_n now takes N=16384 when M<=256 (measured -1.8..-18.0%) and the sampled path keeps it at M>=1024 (small_n is +17..19% there). N=32768 loses at every M so 16384 is the end of the trend. Also: refuse a small_n LDS request over 160 KB, and check hipGetLastError -- forcing small_n at N=65536 previously reported 4.40 us with garbage because the launch never started.

chunk_stride hoisted from the sampler to a kernarg, and sampling geometry split into sample_stride_exact (chooses S, old rule unchanged) + sampling_geometry_ok (decides servability, now masks the stride to a multiple of 4). Serves row widths that are not a multiple of the chunk count, which is every width aiter asks for (num_prefix + num_rows, e.g. 131328 = 2^8*3^3*19, previously refused). Faster than g_3 rather than break-even because the kernel no longer does an integer division the host already knew: outer 42.71-42.72 -> 42.66-42.67 us and decode 30.90 -> 30.84 us on two interleaved A/B rounds. 650 verifies green.
